rtc_assembly_request.manufacturer: Yichang Power Glory Technology Co., Ltd.
rtc_assembly_request.assembly_constraint: Supplier must propose factory-attached insulated flexible leads/tabs and an assembly sequence compatible with pads under the nominal cell. Do not interpret this request as approval to solder a bare cell, trap uninsulated tabs against PCB copper or reflow the battery.

catalog_recheck.method: Anonymous browser rendered search plus successful public API response and positive control; no account login or order action
catalog_recheck.interpretation: No exact public match observed for the selected three SGM series or U22401-17 in this successful search. Not proof of discontinued parts, stock unavailable everywhere, or that JLC cannot register them. Query failures/access-denied responses never count as no-match evidence.

rejected_or_unapproved_catalog_candidate.reason: Manufacturer specifies1.60mm mid-mount and CH-0.02, versus0.80mm and CH0.78 required. Similar XY dimensions do not preserve mounting/Z.
Manufacturer says0.80mm/LCP/gold-flash, not original NYLON/Au3u. Exact current drawing/plating durability and JLC supply acceptance not established. Do not map to -17.
Public record is JLCPCB Assembly/Standard Only/high difficulty and different -05 LCP suffix. Candidate code is not original -17 identity or account acceptance.
Generic unsuffixed model cannot establish exact material/plating/mount variant.

real_account_fields_required: Account-specific receiving instructions and package labels
Actual purchase invoice, currency/unit price and provenance
In Warehouse record and usable quantity before scheduling assembly
warehouse_state_note: These are external JLC statuses, not a mandatory linear transition model. Received or Checked is NOT sufficient for inventory availability. Mainland Awaiting Payment is not treated as a payment authorization.
approval_flags_are_not_proof: Even a plausible C-code or signed text is not authenticated by this software. External supporting documents and deliberate human review are required; no sample/test evidence may be treated as real.
